description: Na₄Mn₃(PO₄)₂(P₂O₇) crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.78 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.56 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.97 Å. There are three inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-64°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.32 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 71°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.34 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with three MnO₆ octahedra, corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-71°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.64 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three MnO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-66°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.66 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four MnO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-54°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three MnO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-72°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.65 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaMn₂P tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₂MnP tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONaMn₂P trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MnP tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MnP tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaMn₂P trigonal pyramids. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom.
